'''''Gone Tomorrow''''' is the thirteenth novel in the [[Jack Reacher series]] written by [[Lee Child]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.goodreads.com/book/show/4494917-gone-tomorrow?from_search=true|title=Gone Tomorrow (Jack Reacher #13) |publisher=[[goodreads.com]]|accessdate=2014-10-10}}</ref> It was published on 23 April 2009 in the United Kingdom and 19 May 2009 in the United States. It is written in the first person.
